units.source_text: 巡回演出艺人辗转于伊豆和相模的温泉浴场，下田港就是她们的旅次。

en.t: Itinerant performers made their rounds through the hot-spring resorts of Izu and Sagami, and Shimoda Harbor was one of the stops on their journey.

units.source_text: 这个镇子，作为旅途中的故乡，飘荡着一种令人爱恋的气氛。

en.t: As a hometown along the road, this town was filled with an atmosphere that made one feel tenderly attached to it.
